scope: Retrospective source handoff for the FR-7 abundance and resting-voltage comparison in Cells decision D238. The published voltage contrast was known before the figure readings were taken.

reported_measurement.observable: total wild-type human Kir2.1 protein after synthesis was stopped
reported_measurement.source: Results text for Figure 4, rounded as printed

digitization.source: Ambrosini et al. The CSV contains approximate group means and SEM read from the original JPEGs. Pixels start at the upper left. Convert each mean_y_px by linear interpolation between the two ticks. SEM is the absolute distance from the mean to the error-bar cap times units per pixel. No time point was assigned to the untreated controls.
